'''Doile''' is a scout from [[Bertome Saighan]]'s Colchaine estate.

== Appearance ==
He is gap-toothed fellow with seamed scars on both cheeks.

== Activities ==
During the [[Seanchan]] campaign against [[Illian]], he reports to Bertome about a Seanchan force containing [[Tarabon]]ers and ''[[damane]]'' drawing in to engage their force.
